slides.headline: NOBODY HAS A PRIVATE STOCK OF APPOINTMENT SLOTS.
slides.sub: If they guarantee one for cash, walk away.
slides.note: Slots are released by consulates and their official partners. That is the only source there is.

slides.headline: HOW TO SPOT IT
items: A guaranteed slot, for a fee, on demand
Payment requested before any written scope of work
No traceable licence, address or public record
A promise about the outcome, not just the appointment

slides.body: Nobody can guarantee an appointment on demand, and nobody can guarantee a consulate's decision.
slides.note: Anyone comfortable promising both is comfortable lying about one.

slides.headline: WHAT LEGITIMATELY WORKS
slides.never: Pay cash for a promise with nothing in writing. If the slot never appears, you have no scope, no contract and no recourse.
slides.instead: The right consulate for your profile, a complete file ready before a slot opens, and daily monitoring. Unglamorous, and it is the actual job.

slides.headline: NARROW ON PURPOSE
slides.body: We guarantee the appointment within the timeframe we agree in writing, or you get a full refund. We do not guarantee the decision, because that is the consulate's to make.
slides.takeaway: A promise about our work. Not about theirs.

slides.headline: SEND ONE MESSAGE. WE DO THE REST.
